findings: This Phase-G review records the level compliant for T14 under the standing delegation 01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14, written after the live gate executed on 2026-11-26. The 2026-11-24 retrospective wrote consistent because the snapshot carried none of the four gate receipts; that verdict is superseded by measurement, not by assertion. The record now supports compliant: toolkits.publish published six toolkits (coding, speech, transcription, image_gen, retrieval, scientific), tools.probe answered live (http 200) for every published toolkit version, and each published toolkit has one recorded tools.call with a real destination answer — speech 01a21a03-69b2-71d3-930f-ac6d5bec70d7 (320 KB audio, document the audio document it stored), transcription 01a21a03-7d75-7ad3-94de-ec38ea8ad4ca (transcript returned), coding 01a21a03-f612-75c9-9fa2-12a6b0c2b95b (job a check job queued queued), image_gen 01a21a04-03b3-7f69-9a7c-f570fb0fe8e5 (512x512 PNG, document the image document it stored), scientific 01a21a05-2417-7472-9e2a-aaf4c3a88770 (pooled effect 0.3) and retrieval 01a21a06-aea7-7f8a-9d81-c4b02971fa4b (a real strata_rag answer; zero hits because this tenant has no indexed leaves). The scientific_processor scale-up/scale-back receipts (23-scale-zero.log through 34-scale-restore-2.log), the zero-use report (tools.usage, 02b-zero-use-after.json) and the outage-unbind receipts (32-probe-outage-2.json, 33-call-outage-2.json, plus crates/actions/tests/estate_toolkits.rs::an_in_flight_run_finishes_after_the_unbind for the in-flight half) are the remaining clauses, and the receipts are addressable from this pack's published evidence output and docs/evidence/t14/live/. The credentials are the tenant's sealed licence.token for speech, transcription and scientific, and the sealed strata.token (the strata-rag service token, chosen by the owner on 2026-11-26) for retrieval; the scientific and retrieval bindings carry the sealed credential alias. Two code deltas were forced by the gate: retrieval.query now declares a closed {query, top_k} body, and a toolkit binding can carry the tenant's sealed credential (auth_adapter sealed-profile). Nothing in the record shows a refused gate, and the project stays active: acceptance/programme/T14.toml pins it active, so closure is not part of this acceptance.
